Path: devpath · 构建是作者的第一道关:错误带位置 | 缺项 (no item reads a refusal string's claim against the parser tier) | P1

## Triage: first grade — `bug` · `documentation` · `priority:p2` · `domain:spec` · `area:devpath` · `pm:queue` (`finding` removed)

Triage: lands in `packages/types/src/zod/**` (126 refusal and `.describe()` strings, plus the shared `neitherContentChannelGuidance` builder) and the matching TS docblocks under `packages/types/src` ⇒ `domain:spec`, the spec lane's objectui contract surface.

Rationale: these strings are what `safeValidateSchema` / `objectui validate` hand an author or an AI. They say 「no error, no warning」, while the parser tier's `not-a-container` warning fires, which PR objectui#10907's dev and its reviewer measured. NORTH-STAR 〈优先级〉 rule 4 (「写给 AI 的文档与 skills 说错一句,等于产品缺陷」) ⇒ **p2**.

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-09-28T10:17Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

**Duplicate check.** Corpus: 2,428 objectui items updated since 2026-09-10T00:00Z, issues only. `no warning|not-a-container` together with `tombstone|content channel|reads-neither` gives 0 hits.

**Execution notes.**
1. Change only the false clause, so it states both tiers truthfully: no render-time error and no element, while the parser tier warns `not-a-container` when the node carries `children`. Do it once, in the shared builder where it applies. Keep every other byte of each string.
2. **Serial:** check PR objectui#10907 (objectui#9256) for hunks on the same files, and declare them in the claim.
3. Pin: the shared builder's sentence, plus one arm-level string, against the parser tier's measured behaviour.

Claim: PM loop round 4
Session: `session_012UwY3ahMixEFkfTUxMVkYm`
Account: `huangyiirene` (the seat's linked user as `GET /user` answers it; the card's assignee)

File surface: the false clause only, in `packages/types/src/zod/tombstone.zod.ts` (`neitherContentChannelGuidance`), in the 12 zod files that carry it as a literal (`ai`, `complex`, `data-display`, `disclosure`, `feedback`, `form`, `layout`, `navigation`, `objectql`, `overlay`, `reports`, `views` `.zod.ts`: 126 occurrences on `main` `5c94589f0`), and in the TS docblocks of the 12 matching `packages/types/src/*.ts` files (139 occurrences). Plus one new pin test under `packages/types/src/__tests__/` and one `.changeset/*.md`. Stop on breach and explain in the report.
Container & model: `M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus` (`dispatch-gates --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectui`: no path-derived mandate)
Clause-②: no — message and `.describe()` text only; every accept or refuse verdict stays byte-identical (auxiliary face).
Thread-read: 5867971242
Serial constraints cleared: PR #10930 (#4356, this seat) edits `packages/types/src/zod/complex.zod.ts` at lines 1289–1306 (the `GlobalFilterSchema` JSDoc). This card's lines in that file are 263–1394, and the nearest are 1084/1096 and 1386/1394, so the regions are disjoint: ordinary concurrency, and the later lander merges `main`. No other open PR touches any of the 25 files or `tombstone.zod.ts` (files API, all open PRs). objectui#9256 (family D) and objectui#10859 are back in `pm:queue` with no slice in flight. objectui#10872's current batch is `public-blocks.zod.ts`, outside this surface. ⚠️ A future family-D slice that adds a tombstone while this sweep is open must use the corrected clause; a note goes to objectui#9256.
